map.当期收益率 = 年息 / 市价。面值 1000、票面利率 5%（年息 50）、市: Current yield = annual interest / market price. With a face value of 1000, a 5% coupon (50 interest) and a market price of 950, the current yield = 50/950 ≈ 5.26%, above the coupon rate because it was bought at a discount.

map.是。市价越低，相对票息与面值的回报越高，收益率上升；价格上涨则收益率下降，这是债: Yes. The lower the market price, the higher the return relative to the coupon and face value, so the yield rises; when the price rises the yield falls. This is the basic bond pricing relation.
